October 28 PPO cohort, 30 training seeds (1000-1029) per setting; joint-delta controller, 50-step ManiSkill 3.0.1 normalized-dense evaluation, 50 episodes per policy and condition. Separate from the historical PickCube study. Cap 4 is best on every axis among eight tested caps, selected ex post by arithmetic mean over that axis's complete grid. This descriptive selection is not held-out evidence. No clear return improvement across the suite; overlapping SD bands are not a significance or equivalence test. All 333 selections have new illustrative CPU-rendered videos of the exact selected seed-1000 checkpoints, using fixed reset seed100000. These are not recovered GPU evaluation episodes or cohort-average trajectories.

methods: Per-policy episode means. Standard nominal median reference. Nonnominal severities averaged within axes, then equal weight per axis.
